thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 95th percentile tail latency on inference-prod for model rwd/main-13b on us-east-1-gpupool. Error rate increased to 6%. Pager triggered.
Nora (oncall): On it, paging now. Joining war-room: https://redwood.warroom/xyz-1765432100
Ethan (serveng): I'm jumping in too. Any recent deploys? checking deploy bot...
deploy-bot: Deploy rwd/runtime-2.4.1 rolled to canary at 1765431800, to prod at 1765431600
Maya (pm): Customer-facing impact? Which routes affected? We might need a statuspage notice.
Priya (sre): Quick checks: 1) KV cache saturation on pool-3 2) GPU memory pressure on nodes a-c 3) autoscale didn't kick (metric window).
Luca (support): I saw a couple of customer tickets about slow responses on /v1/generate, around 2m ago.
Nora (oncall): Assigning incident owner to Ethan. Ethan — owner for mitigation and status updates. :white_check_mark:
Ethan (serveng): Ack. I'll open an internal incident doc and draft status. War-room link is above. Starting mitigation: 1) scale pool-3 by +4 nodes 2) force-evict large KVs 3) if signal persists, rollback runtime to 2.4.0
Priya (sre): I'll action scale and KV evict. Pushing autoscaler fix is risky now. Scaling request sent to infra-runner.
Nora (oncall): Confirming paging: DM to oncall rota sent, escalation to lead oncall if no ack in 2m.
Maya (pm): Draft statuspage snippet:
```
Status: Degraded performance for inference API in US-East
Impact: Increased latency and error rate for some requests to rwd/main-13b
ETA: Under investigation; engineering is mitigating now
```
Ethan (serveng): Edits: add 'We are not seeing data exposure; only latency/errors.' Also add contact link for customers.
Luca (support): I'll prep a customer-facing note for enterprise tenants, linking to statuspage and support contact.
Priya (sre): Scaling complete, +4 nodes added, KV eviction started, GPU memory usage dropping on node-b.
Ethan (serveng): Seeing latency improve on few samples. Error rate down to 2.1%. Continuing to monitor and trace top callers.
Nora (oncall): Nice. Ethan, when you post the statuspage, please include the war-room link and owner. I'll take postmortem owner if we need one.
Ethan (serveng): Status update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1765432100 - Included mitigation steps and contact info.
Maya (pm): Notifying key customers now. Template used: short impact + ETA + support contact. Will update once stable.
Luca (support): Customer A acknowledged, appreciates the proactive updates.
Nora (oncall): Keep this thread for live notes. If any rollback/impactful action, ping #eng-sre and exec-summaries channel. :rocket:
incident-bot: Incident 1765432100 — owner Ethan — status: mitigated -> monitoring
Ethan (serveng): Moving to monitoring; will hand to postmortem if we see recurrence. Thanks everyone.
